implementation.summary: D43 adds a bounded supervised streaming drain to the existing run endpoint. It repeats checkpoint-safe micro-batches, reinitializes bounded provider polls for each cycle, stops after consecutive empty polls or explicit caps, and exposes durable progress and stop reason without claiming an unbounded worker.

security_and_recovery.journey: The real browser/API journey created the stream definition, observed two-partition backlog, drained all 64 messages through the supervised API, confirmed durable lag zero, then exercised an invalid cap request and cleaned PostgreSQL/Redpanda services.
security_and_recovery.negative_paths: The API rejected max_batches=0 with HTTP 400; this is request-boundary evidence, not provider-wide or release-gate evidence.
security_and_recovery.recovery_scope: This campaign does not prove broker restart recovery, sustained indefinite backpressure, external provider breadth, worker supervision or the complete P11 journey. Those cells remain open.

open_cells: P11 remains in_progress: D43 proves one bounded supervised drain against real local Redpanda/Kafka and PostgreSQL, but broker restart recovery, sustained backpressure, worker supervision, broader provider breadth and the complete family journey remain open.
P2 and P14 remain in_progress; D43 does not add connector/provider or external recovery qualification.
P13 remains blocked by external secret-provider qualification and release evidence; no authorized external secret provider or credential was available.
D43 does not rerun the full Python suite, Gitleaks, pip-audit or Trivy; skipped and inherited lanes are not counted as PASS.
No release gate is closed; release remains NO-GO at 1/13 families and 0/10 gates.
limitations: The first supervised campaign drained only 32 of 64 records because the one-shot provider poll object was reused; D43 corrects that implementation issue and the failed receipt is retained as diagnostic evidence, not PASS.
A second campaign reached 1/1 browser PASS but was rejected by the runner audit because page.request did not produce the required traffic evidence; it is not qualification evidence.
The third campaign captured traffic but still drained only 32 of 64 records; it is not qualification evidence.
The final success is one filtered live diagnostic, not a route-wide audit, indefinite soak, broker restart rehearsal, provider matrix or family qualification.
No hosted workflow, branch or worktree was used; license review remains FAIL/CLOSED with 21 human decisions pending.
